filesystem_observation_contract.scope: Worker-local observations only; ref RLock and advisory file lock retain acquisition/unlock/CAS order. Atomic UTF8 text helper retains file fsync -> replace -> directory fsync order and original exception behavior. ObjectStore.get/put counts attempts/returned bytes/successful new files; repair and other direct OS/SQLite writes are not a complete process-I/O census.
filesystem_observation_contract.units: atomic_write_bytes means intended logical UTF8 bytes including failed attempts; object_get_bytes counts successfully returned content; object_put_bytes counts newly written file content. None is physical device/write amplification or durable commit proof.
filesystem_observation_contract.wall_times: Lock/fsync/read wall intervals include scheduling and GIL delay; no claim that all wall time was native device latency. Nested hold intervals overlap; outer hold union avoids adding them twice.
filesystem_observation_contract.totals: Per-operation lifetime filesystem_totals is separate from last256distributions. Final benchmark subtracts before/after completed-worker totals for exact measured logical write/read volume; no process-max/window confusion.
filesystem_observation_contract.privacy_bounds: Fixed subsystem labels only; no SQL, paths, fd values or payloads. Last256per-operation distributions, last64slow invocations and last64named sections per invocation. No warning/deadline changes.
